# Public RAW test fixture

`no_people_bird.nef` is an original Nikon RAW photograph by Tsung-en Hsiao. It
contains a bird at Dahu Park and no people are visible. It is supplied
unchanged so the repository can exercise the real RawTherapee decode and render
path.

Copyright 2026 Tsung-en Hsiao. Licensed under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

The original EXIF metadata, including the location, is intentionally retained
with the photographer's permission. Do not add other RAW files, derived
renders, or sample metadata here without an explicit public-use approval.
